title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1981-03-10
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Warm, excellent matrix capture of a hot 1981 show with dynamic stop‑and‑go moments and great energy.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its warm, crystal‑clear matrix mix that lets listeners feel the band’s live power. Reviewers note a particularly exciting “crash” moment where the band briefly stops then rockets back forward, highlighting an energetic performance throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted both superb matrix sound quality and an exciting live performance, indicating a high‑quality show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, clear matrix mix praised; no reported dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Hot and energetic show with dramatic stop‑and‑go moments that keep the momentum lively.
